I. Magna & neceffaria de re confultatio eft mihi
fufpicienda: quam hifce tibi nunc literis exponere
volui:cum coram tecũ agĕdi facultas nõ concedatur.
II. Eft autē hæc omnis deliberatio:cum ftudiorum
meorũ curfum ad finē prope hac in fchola perduxe-
rim, ideoq; de alia iam fit nunc[?] cogitandū, quid mihi
agendum exiftimes: manendum ne in Germania diu-
tius,an vero in Galliam, aut Italiam eundum.
III. Et, quo facilius tuo mihi adeffe cõfilio queas,
quid utramq; in partem occurrat,paucis indicabo.

page.notes: The three marginal notes at the top right are only partly legible: "Imitatio cõ-", "municato-" and "rii." are read from fragments and may be wrong. The Greek words are uncertain and marked illegible where I could not read them letter by letter. "nunc" in II is doubtful. The last line of the page is cut off by the lower edge of the text block, so the end of "exëpla in-" continues on the next page. No catchword or signature is visible. The book's edge and the dark background are not transcribed.
